title: A* Planner
learning_objectives: Search with path cost plus an admissible heuristic
Use a priority queue with deterministic tie-breaking
Compare node expansions with uniform-cost search
hints: On pop: if `g_of_entry > best_g[state]` skip (compute g = f − h).
Rebuild the path from parents when the goal is popped.

failure_feedback.advice: Stop when the goal is popped, not when it is generated.
Order the heap by f = g + h.
Relax a neighbour only when the new g is strictly smaller; skip stale heap entries.
Popping the start counts as one expansion.
